# DEV Community

> > DEV Community is a collaborative platform where developers learn, share knowledge, build projects, and advance their careers through discussions, educational content, and community challenges.

DEV Community is a Forem-based platform founded by Ben Halpern that serves as a hub for developer education, open-source collaboration, and career growth. The platform offers structured learning paths, hackathons, video tutorials, and branded organization profiles alongside a vibrant discussion community across programming languages and technologies.
